items.title: Can't Let Go (Mariah Carey song)
items.description: "Can't Let Go" is a song recorded by American singer-songwriter Mariah Carey for her second studio album, Emotions (1991). Columbia Records released it as the album's second single in November 1991. Featuring synthesizers and drum programming, "Can't Let Go" is a breakup song in the form of an R&B and pop slow jam. items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. items.title: Sean Duffy
items.description: Sean Patrick Duffy is an American politician, attorney, and former television personality who is serving as the 20th United States secretary of transportation. Duffy previously served as the acting administrator of NASA from July to December 2025. items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. items.title: Ansel Adams
items.description: Ansel Easton Adams was an American landscape photographer and environmentalist known for his black-and-white images of the American West.
